paragraphs: Here are the steps to add money to your MU account.
Adding money to MU is not difficult! Just follow these steps:
Go to the MU Online website and select your preferred login method. Log in with your WEBZEN, Facebook or Google account.
Click ‘here’ to go to the Top Up page.
Note: These 3 login methods are different. The same account is required to log in and top up.
Click on MU and click "Continue".
Choose a payment method. and desired package After that, click on “Continue” (click ‘More payment methods’ to see other payment methods)
Note 1: Payment currency including Bonus Wcoin may vary per payment channel and package. Please check the currency and Bonus Wcoin before making payment.
Note 2: During a Bonus Cash event, the event end time is displayed on the top
Confirm your order and click 'Continue' to pay.
Select payment channel and click ‘Make Payment’.
Scan the QR with your mobile banking app.
If payment is successful, you will be able to check your balance amount on the 'Transaction History' page.
Click here to go to the Transaction History page.
For more information about the webshop, please click on these links.

paragraphs: Here are the steps for purchasing items for your character from the online store.
Buying items is not difficult! Just follow these steps:
Go to MU Online's online item shop. There are various items that can be purchased with Wcoin.
Click ‘here’ to go to the ‘item shop’ page.
Click ‘here’ to go to the ‘top-up’ guide page.
Select a category to find the item you want to buy and click on ‘Buy Now’.
Confirm your order and click on 'Buy' to complete the order. You can check your remaining Wcoin balance on the Purchase Checkout page.
- Purchased items are valid for 1 year from the date of purchase.
- Unused items will be permanently deleted 1 year after the date of purchase.
- Some items can only be [used] in the game.
- Items marked with [SPEED] can only be used in SPEED SERVER.
Click 'Inbox' to view the purchased items or click 'OK' to stay on the store page to purchase additional desired items.
Click ‘here’ to go to the ‘Inbox’ page .
There are 3 categories on the Shopping List page where you can check your items and their status. You can delete items where if deleted the item will be permanently deleted.
Log in to your character and press 'X' to open the in-game X-shop. Select an item and click 'Use' to move the item to your character's storage.

paragraphs: Here are the steps to start MU Online.
Starting MU Online is not difficult! Just follow these steps:
Visit www.webzen.com and create your own WEBZEN.COM account
When you sign up, try to use press button. You can also sign up with Facebook address and you will not need email authentication.
When you click "DOWNLOAD" button on the top right, you will move to the game client download page.
Download the latest game installer.
Install the client installer on your PC.
Click on the 'MU' Icon on your desktop.

Once you see the game client window, you may configure some of the game settings (screen resolution, color depth, sound) by pressing on the 'Setting' button, otherwise continue by pressing 'Game Start'
Lastly, input your WEBZEN.COM account password to validate your account.

headings.text: 3rd Class change requires finished Marlon quest and has 3 parts.

paragraphs: Receive Buff first before going out to hunt!!

Keep hunting with quests. This is the fastest way for level up.
You will meet more quests depending on your level.

Once you have reached level 150, go to the Priestess Sebina in Devias to hear the story of the 'Scroll of Emperor'. You will need to offer a token of 1 Million Zen for the Priestess's story.
The 'Scroll of Emperor', which tells of Muren, the first emperor to unify MU, is said to have been seen around the Lost Tower, Atlans, and the Dungeon.
Legends have been told of the Scroll being enveloped by a great power and whoever reads from the scroll shall be able to wield this power.Once you find the Scroll, go to the Priestess who will aid you in unlocking the Scroll's power.
As you feel the Scroll's power flowing through you, the Priestess relates the story of the peace brought about by Emperor Muren's reign. A historical record of the first emperor Muren contains the commemoration of peace through the triumph of Muren over all warlords, and by doing so, unified the continent into the Empire of MU.

Muren was one of the three Heroes that ended the chaos brought upon the people by Sekneum's invasion.
After the empire was united, people swore loyalty to the emperor. To signify this oath of loyalty the tribes offered three treasures.
The 'Broken Sword' was offered by the dark knights as a symbol of their bravery, loyalty and their wish for prosperity.
The 'Tear of Elf' was offered by the elves as a token of their vow to strengthen the unity between elves and humans. The 'Soul of Wizard' was offered by the dark wizards as a symbol of their vow to dedicate their power for the peace and freedom of the empire. The Priestess can assist you in furthering this quest if you give her a small token for her troubles worth 2 million Zen. She will then task you to seek one of the three treasures depending on which tribe you hail from.
Return the treasure to the priestess to complete this quest. Once you complete this quest you will become either: a Blade Knight, a Soul Master, or a Muse Elf.

The legendary treasure called 'Ring of Glory', once worn by the first emperor Muren has manifested its presence once more within our lands. Whoever possesses the 'Ring of Glory' gains the blessing of Muren. It is said to be found in the deserts across the sea.
Talk to Marlon who will appear in Devias, Lorencia, Noria, or Atlans. He will tell you more about the Ring once you give him a gift of 3 million Zen.
Return to Marlon once you have found the Ring of Glory to complete your transformation into one of the vanguards of the Continent of MU. For Blade Knights who thirst for a greater power talk to Marlon again once you finish this quest.

The Blade Knights possess a power that only they can wield. The ability to string together their techniques have made these knights extremely powerful and no other tribe has been able to emulate this.
The 'Dark Stone' calls out from the deserts.
It calls out to the brave Blade Knights to continue the legacy of their tribe and seek this skill.
Marlon, one of the keepers of the tribe's heritage, invites you to embark on this quest.
He requires an offering of 3 Million Zen as a symbol of your commitment. Bring to him the Dark Stone and unlock the true power of the Blade Knights.

paragraphs: These dedicated warriors train endlessly to perfect their sword techniques.
They channel their high Agility and Physical Strength stats into direct and area attacks like
Twisting Slash, Death Stab and Rageful Blow.
By positioning himself in a defensive posture, a dark knight can reduce the damage taken from enemy strikes by 50%.
It proves very useful when besieged by too many enemies to effectively counter.
The falling slash gives twice as much damage than any other regular attack of a Dark Knight because he uses his whole body to increase the strength of the blow.
Many Dark Knights have been able to master this skill.
It consists of swinging a sword in a wide arc thereby generating enough centrifugal power to cause more damage and increase attack speed.
Dark Knights who use the Legendary Sword, Gladius and Katana with a lunge skill can execute quick stab attacks on their enemies.
Moreover, it penetrates deeply through an opponent's armor into the vital parts of the opponent.
It cleaves into an enemy through an upward slashing motion.
While it may look simple and fluid, it takes a lot of dedication to master it.
It is a dreadful skill that uses both blades of a sword to cut an enemy.
It is a skill of high difficulty that only a Giant Sword, Chaos Dragon Axe and Crystal Sword can handle.
Monsters who are attacked by this skill are damaged 2 times more than the other attacks.
This technique allows the knight wielding a spear weapon to impale his opponents for massive damage.
A technique that allows the knight to whirl his weapon around him to attack all adjacent targets.
A devastating attack similar to the lunge skill but is enhanced by the elemental power of wind.
This technique allows the knight to use his energies to give him more stamina for battle.
An area attack that unleashes shockwaves with the elemental power of the earth to damage opponents.

headings.text: B. Rune Mage Character Basic Setting

paragraphs:
The Rune Mage is a half-elf who were born between the mage of Arka, an alliance of nobility, and the fairy who created the Altar of the Wolves.
As inter-species breeding is frowned upon in the Mu empire, they had to leave the empire and found a settlement called Iria and lived in peace.
When they came of age, the Lemuria Legion came to the village. They were heading to the front to join the Siege of Crywolf.
The Arka and the villagers tried to protect their village, but they were quickly overcome by the legionnaires.
In the chaos, the Rune Mage lost his parents. After the battle, the Rune Mage headed toward Noria for revenge.
-  Rune Mage's resources can be upgraded with character stats and items.
① Character stats can be upgraded with the stat points that players acquire when gaining a level or by using items.
① The Rune Mage is an offensive spellcaster who amplifies its Spellpower with Energy.
② They can cast more than two spells at a time to inflict serious damage over a wide area.

◈ 1st Class Change Quest
- Finding The Book of The Warlord
- The Three Artifacts of Mu (Mage's Spirit)

◈ 2nd Class Change Quest
- A Rightly Hero

◈ 3rd Class Change Quest
- Level 380: Proving Strength
- Level 400: Infiltrating the Valgath Barracks
- Level 400: Into the Darkness
① The Rune Mage can cast some warlock spells that he learned from his father's research and some unique spells available only to him.
① The Rune Mage uses a unique weapon called the Rune Mace and a shield.
② The Rune Mage can equip five armor pieces including helm, armor, pants, gloves, and boots.

paragraphs: New Character Slayer Appears!!
A demi-human bat character with the capability to engage in quick combat with her bat-like abilities.
Uses a short sword(dagger) and engages in battle by throwing her weapon or charging into
multiple enemies far away.
1. Slayer Background Story
The slayer was originally born from Lorencia and was reincarnated through experiments in Kundun which turned her into a half-human half-bat
demi-human.1896 of Lugard ’s calendar, the demi-human experiment was discovered by Kundun’s forces in Kanturu.
To increase the power of their forces, they use the experiment to create demi-humans.
The slayer is the first successful demi-human created from the experiment.
Relentless Assassin...
After being abducted by the Kundun forces,
the slayer was recreated to become an obedient killing machine with no emotions.
A revered advanced demi-human with the intellectual of a human and the ability to
track and detect using sonar like a bat.
With her advanced tracking, detecting, and killing abilities,
she was used as an assassin by Kundun to assassinate traitors and those who were planning to commit acts of treason.
While she was working as a follower of Kundun, her human-like emotions
were being awakened by a mysterious woman.
She later discovers that the mysterious woman she assassinated as a traitor was her mother. She escapes the grasp of Kundun after discovering everything that has happened to her.
Now, away from the hands of Kundun, she battles with the will to assassinate him.

paragraphs: Season 16 Part1-1 New Character - Gun Crusher
A. New Character - Gun Crusher
The MU Empire secretly established the Imperial Corps in order to overcome the attacks of the Kundun forces.   They kidnapped a healthy boy from Goa and subjected him to harsh training.

The boy, who was called Fisher, went through the harsh training of the Imperial Society,   eventually losing himself in the training process and becoming a member of the Imperial corps loyal to the MU Empire.
Imperial Society - Appointed as a Gun Crusher, Fisher is ordered to annihilate monsters as his first mission and heads to Elveland.
B. Gun Crusher Exclusive Skills

Gun Crusher can fire Dark Plasma at enemy targets or at specific coordinates.
Dark Plasma does not move from the location where it is used,
 and can inflict damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds.

When Gun Crusher uses Ice Break in the direction of the enemy,
ice is created in front of him, dealing damage once,
 and then one more time with the broken ice shards.

Gun Crusher fires randomly towards the front.
 Attacks constantly with very high attack speed,
dealing damage to enemies at a sectoral range.

(1) White Wizard : Kundun Mephis
① Utilizing the opposite Element as that of the Dark Wizard,
the White Wizard uses Staves and Magic Books as Weapons and holy magic Skills using "Light Energy".
② Has low DEF but high Magic ATK.
You can strengthen your magic with the Energy Stat.
③ The "Bond Buff" is activated when in a Party together with Lemuria, his apprentice.
You can deal more DMG with strengthened magic Skills from the "Bond Buff".
① The Mage uses the "Orb"
to use magic Skills in the form of "spheres".
② Has low HP and DEF but high Magic ATK,
and you can strengthen your magic with the Energy Stat.
Although not as good as the Elf, can use similar support magic that helps in combat.
③ The "Bond Buff" is activated when in a Party together with Kundun, her teacher.
You can deal more DMG with strengthened magic Skills from the "Bond Buff".
* Kundun and Lemuria's Relation
- Kundun is Lemuria's teacher, and Lemuria is a woman that loves Kundun.
① After the discovery of the "Doppelganger Fortress" in MU Year 1022,
a Grand Sage from MU infiltrates the Fortress and meets the Doppelganger.
② With the strong intention to stop the evil Kundun, the Sage borrowed the Doppelganger's strength and started researching it,
with the research proving successful enough to produce the magic ability to create Doppelgangers.
③ A catalyst was needed for a Doppelganger to be created
and the Sage needed a Doppelganger of a person strong enough to stop Kundun.
Objects used by Kundun and Lemuria were obtained with the help of the priests that serve Lugard,
and with them as the catalysts, Kundun and Lemuria's Doppelgangers were made.
④ The Doppelgangers were identical in not only appearance but also memories, abilities, and personalites.
⑤ Under the guidance of their creator, the Doppelgangers developed kind and righteous hearts and the qualities of a White Wizard and a Mage,
and when the time came, the Sage sent Kundun and Lemuria on their way.
For the purpose of the good Doppelgangers to defeat their evil original selves and save the continent of MU….

paragraphs: 1) Character Introduction
(1) Illusion Knight:  Jacquard
① A knight wielding the power of illusion, the Illusion Knight summons an Illusion Blade in his left hand to use Skills through various forms of Sword Energy.
② Has average DEF and high ATK.
③ Can enhance Skill ATK and ATK through the Dexterity Stat.
Born as an incarnation of Kundun, Jacquard had exceptional swordcraft and ability as a knight to surpass his peers without much effort,
but was not at all acknowledged as a Magic Gladiator due to his inability to wield a Magic Sword or use Magic, despite being a descendant of the Gladiators.
Jacquard has long since blamed his lack of ability and kept his heritage a secret.
He however had his moment of reckoning in the most unexpected of situations.
An illusion of his blade formed in the left hand he subconsciously held up in an attempt to defend against his opponent’s sword during training.
It was a new opportunity for Jacquard, who longed to be acknowledged.
Jacquard wasted no time honing his skills with illusions, and was soon able to create illusions of his weapons at will or create illusions of himself.
Having the ability that no one else had, the moment that he so desired finally had come.
There was hardly anyone in the continent of MU that did not know of Jacquard, who earned Kundun’s trust and was acknowledged by him.
Everything was going in Jacquard's favor for a while.
As his reputation grew, Jacquard’s loyalty towards Kundun only burned brighter,
and as his loyalty grew, it seemed as Kundun’s trust towards him was becoming much stronger.
One fateful day, Jacquard receives an order from Kundun in secret.
The order was to infiltrate the Blood Castle, a key strategic location, and destroy the barrier protecting it. Immediately taking action, Jacquard successfully carried out the mission.
Deeming the movements of Lemuria’s forces near the Lost Tower strange however,
Jacquard makes a report to Kundun and soon receives additional orders to investigate.
Lemuria’s forces noticed right away they were being tailed, and viciously attacked Jacquard with extreme hostility.
Lost in the heat of battle, Jacquard noticed there was not a single soul that was fighting alongside him.
The Lost Tower. Was this not the place full of Kundun’s subordinates?
Not knowing why he has to fight the enemy all by himself, Jacquard fights only to save his life.
Although able to save his life due to his illusion training, the heavily injured Jacquard loses conciousness while escaping into the depths of the Lost Tower.
How much time has passed?
Barely coming to his senses, Jacquard is engulfed in an uncontrollable rage. Kundun has forsaken me.
I, who am his incarnation. I, who pledged my loyalty. Jacquard knows only a path of burning retribution will save him now.
Only vengeance towards Kundun will help him escape the Lost Tower, where masses of Lemuria’s forces and Kundun’s subordinates aim their swords at him.
Renewed with vengeance as his new purpose, Jacquard enters combat once more with his Illusion Blade in hand.
Although countless enemies have fallen by his sword, his rage does not relent.
He goes forth. Until coming face to face with the Balrog, the ruler of the Lost Tower. The Balrog was a strong opponent.
An opponent that Jacquard had to put his life on the line for. A fierce battle ensued.
Jacquard faces his opponent with all his might. He had no intention of dying in the Lost Tower.
To Jacquard, there was an even greater opponent, an opponent that he must take down.
If he falls, he rises again. He wields his sword despite the pain.
Becoming one with the powerful energy of the sword, Jacquard delivers the final blow.
Thus the Balrog falls at last.
Jacquard escapes the Lost Tower drenched in the Balrog’s blood.
Forging his own path as the Illusion Knight, he strides towards a new battlefield to exact vengeance on Kundun.
Creation Requirements
Illusion Knight / Magic Gladiator / Elf

 He goes forth. Until coming face to face with the Balrog, the ruler of the Lost Tower. The Balrog was a strong opponent.
 An opponent that Jacquard had to put his life on the line for. A fierce battle ensued.
 Jacquard faces his opponent with all his might. He had no intention of dying in the Lost Tower.
 To Jacquard, there was an even greater opponent, an opponent that he must take down.
 If he falls, he rises again. He wields his sword despite the pain.
 Becoming one with the powerful energy of the sword, Jacquard delivers the final blow.
 Thus the Balrog falls at last.
 Jacquard escapes the Lost Tower drenched in the Balrog’s blood.
 Forging his own path as the Illusion Knight, he strides towards a new battlefield to exact vengeance on Kundun.

(1) Alchemist is a ‘magic type’ character who uses alchemy using materials.
(2) Uses Wand (Main Weapon) and Elixir (Secondary Weapon) as weapons.

A girl named Leah, with genius alchemy skills, is born in Elveland, a land inhabited by a mysterious race. She began to shine by learning alchemy
when she was eight years old and could read and write, and by the age of nine, she had succeeded in transmuting substances into 'gold'.
Her parents and the villagers kept it a secret from her because they knew that she would be in danger if her existence was known to the outside world.
However, as the money from selling gold made the villagers' lives better and Leah converting more than half of the materials in the village into gold,
this led to her existence being revealed to the outside world. When this fact became known to the outside world, especially to Kundun's ears,
Leah's parents were brutally murdered during Kundun's invasion of Elveland in order to take her away.
With the help of the villagers, Leah was able to escape alone out of the village and escape Kundun, but having experienced everything firsthand,
Leah lives with only one animosity towards Kundun, and learns how to fight through her specialty, alchemy,
and sets out on an adventure to defeat Kundun at the young age of 16. Carrying the burden of thinking that all the bad things that happened were her fault,
she stopped turning things into gold and only studies and uses combat alchemy.

paragraphs: 1. Burning Kethotum & Old Kethotum
Under the protection of Muren and Runedil, Etramu began creating a new barrier by moving the Sealed Stone to Kethotum
with the plan to lure Kundun to Kethotum and completely seal him with the ultimate sealing magic.
If the plan succeeded, Kundun would become one with the Dark God and could never be saved,
but it was too dire a situation to take into account. Etramu's plan was a complete success.
Solely focused on destroying the Sealed Stone, Kundun fell right into the trap.
Even Kundun, infused with the power of the Dark God, was no match against the sealing magic's magic field, made by dividing the Sealed Stone into 8 pieces.
The 8 pieces burned a bright red while letting out a thunderous roar,
and the betrayed Kundun howled in fury as he turned into stone. As Kundun was completely put to rest, the Sealed Stone finally went quiet and came back to its original form.
Etramu immediately gathered the 8 pieces and completed the sealing magic.
Kundun was now forever sealed in Kethotum, the lost city,
and it seemed eternal prosperity had come to MU.
After Kundun was sealed thanks to the efforts of the three heroes, Muren, Etramu, and Runedil,
Lemuria, Kundun's best pupil, seized the opportunity to
take control of the mind of Gaion, whom Muren served dearly, and cause a rebellion.
Lemuria tries to undo the seal through Gaion but ends up failing due to Etramu's seal break prevention magic,
killing Gaion and severely damaging herself and going into a thousand-year slumber.
After a thousand years, Lemuria awakens and succeeds in resurrecting Kundun
after taking control of Antonias, a descendant of Gaion.
The resurrected Kundun tries to take control of MU using Secrarium without reviving it,
summoning portals throughout MU to bring in his minions,
turning MU into a burning battlefield once again.

paragraphs: New Hunting Ground Tomenta Island
This is a tale before Elveland existed.

After Elve was annihilated by Lemuria the Elveans escaped to the giant island above “Tormenta Island” that was absorbing its energy. To stop further attacks from Lemuria, the Elveans formed Iruha’s Wall to protect the giant island.
After failing to destroy Iruha’s Wall, Lemuria proceeds to take control of the island’s energy source, “Tormenta Island” by sending her minions and seals it off entirely.

The Elveans fall into a comatose state after forming Iruha’s Wall, and after Lemuria’s seal on “Tormenta Island” weakens, they slowly begin to regain consciousness and form the Elveland of current day.
Although Lemuria’s seal on “Tormenta Island” has worn off, Lemuria’s influence still remains on it,

and although approaching “Tormenta Island” was quite difficult due to it radiating powerful energies, the energies have weakened after the island was sealed off for a long time, and the island became known to the world after the seal had completely worn off.
Most of Lemuria’s minions have been eradicated, but some have become Spirit-type Monsters after fusing with the island’s powerful energies, becoming the new masters of “Tormenta Island’.

paragraphs: Located on the eastern side of the MU Continent, Karutan is surrounded by high mountain ranges, making it a closed and barren region, and is known as one of the regions where travel between regions is impossible.

In particular, the northwest of Karutan was an ashen tower inhabited by various monsters, making it difficult for anyone to approach.Then one day, the nomads of Karutan were able to see strangers from an unknown continent landing, and they cooperated with the strangers to subdue the monsters of the inaccessible Ashen Tower, establishing their own new civilization.

But it could not last long. In the process of subduing the monsters, Kardamahal's magic circle that had been sealing the powerful monsters underground in Karutan began to crack and reached an uncontrollable limit…

Eventually, with a loud explosion and a loud noise, Kardamahal's magic circle was completely destroyed. When the magic circle of Kardamahal that had been sealing the powerful monsters was destroyed, a large number of the unsealed monsters instantly headed towards the surface of Karutan, causing the mountain range that had been divided based on the central stronghold to distort and form a new terrain.
As new terrain was formed and powerful monsters from Kardamahal rose through the destroyed magic circle, they took up positions throughout 'Distorted Karutan' and began attacking adventurers.

paragraphs:
Season 20 Part 2-2 New Hunting Ground: Swamp of Destruction
  1) Background Story

Explorers, following the command of the MU Empire, began investigating the Swamp of Peace that Mallone had discovered. Assisted by the heroes of the MU Continent, the explorers investigated the four islands within the Swamp of Peace and confirmed the presence of Medusa and new life forms. They also found traces of a civilization across the four islands, discovering statues, the square and altar on the western island, and a cemetery on the southern island. Yet, surprisingly, no people were found.

Uncertain whether the civilization had been destroyed by the suddenly appearing Medusa and monsters, or had vanished for some other reason, the explorers decided to activate a non-functioning magic circle. The explorers gathered the scattered fragments of the destroyed magic circle, rebuilt them into a statue, and, with the help of wizards, activated the circle.

However, unlike the Swamp of Peace's magic circle, this one generated a purple column of ominous light, sparks began to fly, and light streamed from the eyes of the statue. The heroes and wizards were hesitant to use the magic circle due to the ominous energy. But upon the explorers' request, the heroes eventually proceeded first, with the explorers and wizards following shortly after. They realized they had been transported to the middle of a vast, desolate, dark island. As the explorers' eyes adjusted to the gloom, they saw, far in the distance, the monsters they had observed in the Swamp of Peace.

The difference this time was that strong sparks were now emanating from around the monsters' bodies. The explorers realized that long ago, when the magic circle was active, the monsters had been transferred from this gigantic island to the Swamp of Peace, and those who were attacked by the monsters had destroyed the magic circle.
While the monsters that moved to the Swamp of Peace via the magic circle weakened the farther, they got from this island, this place is still filled with creatures capable of bringing ruin to all.

This is the Swamp of DESTRUCTION.

paragraphs: After the 5th Class Advancement, character can be further strengthened
by crafting Ability Cards by using Ability Crystals and equipping the cards in Ability Upgrade Core ' Slots.

paragraphs: ■ Who is NPC Moss the Gambler?
Moss is a mysterious merchant who gives out items randomly. With a small percentage of chances he will give you a rare item that never existed in the Continent of MU.
■ What is the story behind?
NPC Moss the Gambler has arrived in the Continent of MU after travelling to faraway lands.
Exotic items that he has collected throughout his voyage have become the center of attention among Mutizens. Never existed before, these items seem very powerful just by a glance.
Other merchants do not welcome Moss as his way of selling items, which is more like a gamble, do not respect the existing business manners.

Every purchase an items type (Normal/Excellent/Rare), skill, luck and option will be given randomly.

Gameplay Improvement
 1. Death Penalty EXP Recovery
1) Addition of Death Penalty EXP Recovery Item
- An item that allows you to recover EXP lost due to Death Penalty was added.
- The item is a paid item sold in the in-game shop.
 [Item Info]

You can recover EXP
 lost due to death.
Maximum Number of Stacks

2) EXP Recovery Settings
- Recovery is only possible for regular characters, and Outlaw characters cannot use this feature.
- Recovery is possible within 24 hours from the time you received the death penalty.
- The number of items required for Recovery is determined by the Character's Level and the amount of EXP consumed.
- In MU Red, Recovery is possible for free once a day without consuming any items.
- Up to 10 EXP Recovery entries can be registered, and if the limit is exceeded, the oldest entry will be deleted.
3) How to Recover EXP Recovery
- When a Death Penalty occurs, an ‘EXP Recovery icon’ will appear in the upper left corner of the game screen.
- You can open the 'EXP Recovery UI' through the icon shown.
- You can recover Penalty EXP by clicking on the desired item in the UI window.
       (Warning: If the amount of recovered EXP is greater than the amount of EXP required for the next level up, only the amount of EXP required for the next level up will be recovered.)
※ When using [Character Transfer], [Server Transfer], or [Character Name Change] premium products, all character Death Penalty recovery items will be deleted.

paragraphs: A. Convert Monster Soul
1)    The content, Convert Monster Soul has been added to the hunting areas.
2)    By converting monster souls, items such as Ruud, Jewels, Options, and Accessories can be received as a reward.
2.    Convert Monster Soul Content Info
(1)    The content can be played by converting monster souls using the Monster Soul Converter item.
(2)    While carrying the Monster Soul Converter item, collect the Monster Soul of the corresponding monster displayed on the item.
Once the required number of souls are collected, the Converter can be converted into reward items.
(3)    There are a total of 5 Monster Soul Converters with varying levels.
The required monsters and rewards vary based on the Converter.
①    The level of difficulty of the required monsters and the quality of the rewards increase with higher level Converters.
<Misc. info regarding Monster Soul Converters>
* Only one converter can be carried in the inventory at a time.
* Only a certain number of purchases can be made per week (Resets on Thursday).
* The item expires the next Thursday, regardless of when it was purchased.
If the item duration expires, the item will not be useable.
(However, if all the souls are collected before the duration, it becomes a permanent item.)
* Every Thursday, the type of monster soul required will change.
3.    How to play Monster Soul Conversion Content
1)    Purchase Monster Soul Converter
(1)    Purchase Monster Soul Converters from the Ruud Shop through the NPC ‘Priest James’ in Elveland.
①    In the Ruud Shop, check the tooltip on the Monster Soul Converter to see the required monster souls.
(2)    Monster Soul Converters cannot be purchased from 00:30 - 11:00 on Thursdays.
2)    Collect Monster Soul
(1)    While carrying the Monster Soul Converter item, defeat the corresponding monster displayed on the item.
(2)    When monsters are defeated, there is a certain chance that their soul can be collected.
①    Collected souls are shared with party members.
(If there are party members collecting the same type of soul.)
②    For the MU Blue Server, the user cannot receive souls while receiving the fatigue penalty.
(3)    The monster souls are collected by the Converter.
(4)    The required monster souls can be found in the tool tip, as well as the quest info screen,
and the Warp(M) screen.
①    They are only displayed when a Monster Soul Converter is in the inventory.
3)    Convert Monster Soul
(1)    If the required souls have been collected, rewards can be claimed by right-clicking on the Converter.
(2)    The type of reward can be selected and received.
[Soul Converter Reward Type]
- 2 rewards can be received after selecting the type of reward.
(Rewards include a guaranteed reward and a random reward.)
- Better rewards can be received with higher level Monster Soul Converters.
- The rewards may change periodically.

7th Guardian - Tauros
 1. Introduction
1) 7th Guardian 'Tauros', 'Tauros (Rare)' have been added.
- Tauros (Rare) is a Guardian with the same stats as the regular Tauros, but with a different color, and can be obtained with a low probability.
- The 7th Guardian is a mount item that is equipped in the inventory.
   - The 7th Guardian can be obtained through a combination of upgrades from the 6th Guardian.
2. 7th Guardian Acquisition
1) Guardian Upgrade Combination

- Guardian upgrades can be combined through the NPC 'Trainer' located in Lorencia (122, 110).
  - Upgrading is possible from Guardian +11 level of the previous tier, and the combination success rate varies depending on the level.
- The required materials for combining items include the 'Seal of Tauros' item and 'Jewel Item'.
- If the combination fails, the secondary material items will disappear, and the Guardian used as the primary material will revert to level +0.
- If the upgrade combination is successful, the Guardian's normal options and elite resistance options will be randomly reassigned.
- When upgrading a Guardian with 3 general options, at least 2 of those options will be randomly reassigned.  (However, the elite resistance option will always be randomly reassigned.)

headings.text: What to do in illusion temple

paragraphs: To enter the illusion event you must form a party consisting of 5 people.
Once the event start has been announced you have 5 minutes time to go to the Illusion Temple NPC (Event square 189,21) and register for the level range you are in:

Mirage - Event square (189,21)
 Illusion Temple NPC

The event consists out of two teams(randomly generated - max 2 teams of 5 ppl) who will try to get as many items from the Stone Henge NPC as possible. Once a player has received the item he will be slowed. Returning the item to the base camp will get the team 1 point. The players will not be able to use their skills in battle. They will be granted skills only when killing adversaries. Also the players look will change just like in chaos castle.
When you enter you are warped inside the waiting room until illusion temple starts, when it starts teams are putted together 'alliance' and 'illusion' team. Teams are random meaning u cannot chose your ally nor your opponent.

In illusion temple the purpose of the game is to capture the 'illusion temple ball' located in the north and in the south of the map you must return these to a container at your starting place
* note: your running speed while carrying the ball will decrease dramatically making u slow and easy to catch* when the ball carrier is killed he drops the ball when u return the ball to your starting place ur team will gain 1 point max points is 7
when u kill an opponent u will gain 5killpoints this is ur personal score and not from the team these points are to use special abilities inside illusion temple
magic shield order: 5pt: function:Prevents 100% of DMG, duration 15 sec resistance order: 5pt: function: Paralyzes the enemy for 15 sec. tracking order: 10pt: function: teleports you to the Ball freeze time: 5pt: function: Takes enemy 50% of SD
Once the event starts, players who are in are assigned to a random team and get a team uniform.

Here's a look at the layout of the zone.
You can see the team's two starting positions on the westernmost and easternmost sides of the map.
For each opposing player killed, the killing team gets five skill points which can be spent to temporarily improve their character during the event. On top of killing other players, there are 2 statues located in the event map, each holding an event ball.

Each team's base also comes equipped with a pedestal, where players can bring back the event balls for points. Once a ball is taken from a status, both statues disappear.
They reappear again once a team returns the ball to their respective base.

The first team which is able to return the ball seven times first wins. So not only is it important to kill the opposing team as much as possible, but to also gather as many event balls as possible while preventing the opposing team from doing the same. The ball carrier will move in slow motion, so it's important for his or her teammates to work together to protect the ball carrier from the opposing team. Once a ball carrier is killed, DC;s or eaves the event; the ball will fall to the ground and is able to be picked up by any player on either team.

paragraphs: Below are the specific guide and details regarding the speed server evnet
Acquiring Ruud from Speed Server Event
■ Ruud is given as a settlement reward for each Speed Server level achieved.
※ After the server transfer, you can receive it through the Gremory Case (shortcut key: K).
Additional Ruud is given for each Speed Server level up.
- [100] Ruud is given automatically to Inventory for every 1 level starting from Master Level (Lv. 400)
※ Up to 40,000 Ruud can be obtained from Lv.401 to Lv.800.
4th Advancement on Speed Server
■ The 4th Advancement is not possible on Speed Servers.
- Depending on the Speed Server level expansion, you can go up to level 800,
but the 4th Advancement Quest is not possible on the Speed Server.
For characters grown on the Speed Server, please use the 4th Advancement quest after transferring to a regular server.
Transfer of character to other server after the Speed Server Event
The Server Transfer start and end date can be found at the notice and webpage. All servers are avaible for transfer from the Speed server.
■ Can I receive mission rewards if I use premium services after transferring to a regular server?
No, you cannot receive rewards.
Since you can receive mission rewards based on the data at the time of transfer from the Speed Server to the main server,
if you use premium services such as [Server Transfer / Character Transfer / Character Name Change],
you will not be able to receive rewards even if you meet the mission reward conditions.
Transfer of character during and after the Speed Server event period
When transferring from a Speed Server to a regular server, you can purchase and use a Speed Server Transfer Coupon for free.
Please refer to the instruction below on how to purchase and use the Server Transfer coupon.
■ How to purchase a Premium Server Transfer Coupon for the Speed Server
1) Purchase [EVENT]Speed Server Transfer item for 0 coin at in-game shop.
2) Go to [MU Homepage Store] – [Shop] - [Premium Coupon], check the “Speed Server Transfer" product, and click [Use].
※ The account must be logged in for more than 10 minutes to use the service normally.
※ Speed Server transfer products do not require identity verification during use.
4) After applying for transfer according to the procedure, the service will proceed when you click the Start button.
How do I use Archangel's Absolute Weapon on the Speed Server?
■ What is the [SPEED] Absolute Weapon Box?
- This item is sold at the Speed Server Exclusive store and can be purchased at the Homepage store and In-game shop.
- After purchasing the item, throw the Absolute Weapon Box in your inventory on the floor
to obtain 11 Archangel's Absolute Weapon (7 days) item that fits your class.
※ The Magic Gladiator class can acquire the Archangel's Absolute Staff or the Archangel's Absolute Sword depending on the stats they have.
- Items once acquired cannot be exchanged. (Ex: Cannot exchange Magic Gladiator Sword → Staff)
Is it possible to use premium services on the Speed Server?
Speed Server allows you to use premium services for the items below.
- Stat Adjustment / Master Skill Reset / Server Transfer
※ Character Name Change, Character Transfer, and Skill Enhancement Tree Reset products cannot be used.
However, the Server Transfer Premium Service can only be used during the transfer period
when transferring from a Speed Server to a regular server.
I would like to know about the 1st and 2nd Lucky Ticket Packages.
■ What is a Lucky Ticket Package?
This package is sold at the Speed Server store and can be purchased at the Homepage store and In-game Shop.
When using the ticket, you can obtain lucky items such as Armor/Gloves/Helmet/Boots/Pants.
It is sold in 1st/2nd Lucky Ticket Packages depending on your level.
1) 1st Lucky Ticket Package: Obtain Armor/Gloves/Helmet/Boots/Pants that can be worn from level 1
2) 2nd Lucky Ticket Package: Obtain Armor/Gloves/Helmet/Boots/Pants that can be worn from level 150
※ Magic Gladiator cannot exchange Lucky Helmet item, and Rage Fighter cannot exchange Lucky Glove item.
※ Purchase cancellation is not possible after using Lucky Ticket Package items.
■ How to use Lucky items in the game
1) After purchasing a lucky ticket, the lucky ticket will be sent to your inventory when you use it in your storage.
2) Right-click the lucky ticket item in your inventory.
※ When used, it is exchanged for an item that matches the character's job, and the item's enhancement level is randomly generated.
※ Lucky items provided cannot be sold/discarded/traded.
■ How to repair lucky item's durability
1) Unequip the lucky item you wish to repair and place it in inventory.
2) Drag the Jewel of Extension item to the lucky item
※ The durability of lucky items can be repaired using Jewel of Extension item.
※ If durability becomes 0, repair is no longer possible.
■ How to deal with lucky items with 0 durability
1) Click the dismantle button in your inventory (I) (the mouse cursor shape changes to dismastle)
2) When you click the [Lucky Item > Confirm] button, the lucky item is dismantled.
※ Dismantled lucky items disappear from the inventory.
How do I purchase cash products from the Speed Server?
Please use the exclusive Speed Shop on the Homepage store and In-game shop.
※ Unused Speed Server products will be deleted when the Speed Server ends.
※ Please be sure to use the products during the event period.
During the event period, special items will be provided when transferring to this server depending on the character level achieved.
Don't forget to transfer to a regular server before the event ends so you don't miss out on the rewards!
I am curious about the achievement rewards for each Speed Server level.
During the event period, special items will be provided when transferring to this server depending on the character level achieved.
Don't forget to transfer to a regular server before the event ends so you don't miss out on the rewards!
I transferred from a Speed Server to a regular server, but my items disappeared.
When transferring from a Speed Server to a regular server,
all items equipped and possessed on the Speed Server will be deleted and only some information will be transferred.
In addition, settlement reward items will be provided based on the Character Lv. achieved on the Speed Server.

1. Earring of Frost
  1) The 8th Mastery earring, 'Earring of Frost' has been added.
- Mastery Earrings provide a 'Earring Set Option' effect when you wear both the left and right earrings of the same tier.
   - You can enhance items up to level 15 using the Lapidary Stones obtained through the Chaos Goblin NPC.

paragraphs: MU Lite is an event application which can be enjoyed by linking PC MU Online game account and is open for all global users.
By playing MU Online, you may acquire Dimensional Key and receive MU Lite items by using them.
On the other hand, when you play MU Lite, you may acquire Hero Token which is used for the MU Online items as a rewards.
2. What is the minimum system requirement?
Minimum Requirements: Android 6.0 / iOS 12.0
If you use a version of OS lower than the minimum requirement, it may not be smooth to use the game,
and it may not be possible to support specification-related inquiries and troubleshooting through customer support.
3. What is new in MU Lite Season 2?
Unlike the previous Season of MU Lite, the game has been renewed with more dynamic and strategic elements including view
switch (landscape to portrait switch), moving direction change, and new systems of conquering towers.
There are three modes of matches: Season Mode, League Mode, and Single Mission Mode.

Season Mode is the main mode for the new MU Lite. Egg and Points can be obtained through victory at Season Mode. The Season Mode can be enjoyed by 1:1 or 2:2. Rewards can vary depending on the points.
League Mode is open 3 times a day and can be participated only when the League Mode is open. Through victory, you can reach higher Tier and Ranking. Loss will bring points deduction.
Single Mission Mode can be played by using an energy ticket and will allow you to face the NPC. Upon victory, unit cards, gold and other rewards can be acquired.
4. How do I acquire Gems?
Gems can be purchased through MU Online web-shop. After purchase, the purchased gem will be shown at game lobby.
* Please tap the refresh button next to the gem to apply the purchased gem.
5. How can I get an Energy Ticket?
Energy tickets will be recharged after a certain amount of time. It can also be purchased by using gem or obtained by watching advertisement.
6. What is Hero Token?
Hero Token can be used to spin the Hero Token Roulette. Roulette offers various PC MU online items, and the Hero Token can be acquired through game play of MU Lite.
7. What is Dimensional Roulette?
Dimension Key can be acquired by hunting monsters at PC MU Online. The number of Dimension key in possession can be viewed at MU Online banner.
The Dimension Key can be used to spin the Dimension Key Roulette, and you can acquire transformation stone.
Please refer the following Website: muonline.webzen.com/en/events/mulite

paragraphs: Season 16 Part1-1 New Character - Gun Crusher
A. New Character - Gun Crusher
The MU Empire secretly established the Imperial Corps in order to overcome the attacks of the Kundun forces.   They kidnapped a healthy boy from Goa and subjected him to harsh training.

The boy, who was called Fisher, went through the harsh training of the Imperial Society,   eventually losing himself in the training process and becoming a member of the Imperial corps loyal to the MU Empire.
Imperial Society - Appointed as a Gun Crusher, Fisher is ordered to annihilate monsters as his first mission and heads to Elveland.
B. Gun Crusher Exclusive Skills

Gun Crusher can fire Dark Plasma at enemy targets or at specific coordinates.
Dark Plasma does not move from the location where it is used,
 and can inflict damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds.

When Gun Crusher uses Ice Break in the direction of the enemy,
ice is created in front of him, dealing damage once,
 and then one more time with the broken ice shards.

Gun Crusher fires randomly towards the front.
 Attacks constantly with very high attack speed,
dealing damage to enemies at a sectoral range.
Elveland NPC - James (Ruud Shop)

Gun Crusher attacks targets around him.
 Ice is created where Gun Crusher fires, dealing damage to the enemy target.
Elveland NPC - James (Ruud Shop)

Gun Crusher makes a strong attack towards the enemy, and at the same time creates a shock wave around the character.
Deals damage to enemies in front, and also deals damage in a range of shock waves.

paragraphs: Here are the steps to add money to your MU account.
Adding money to MU is not difficult! Just follow these steps:
Go to the MU Online website and select your preferred login method. Log in with your WEBZEN, Facebook or Google account.
Click ‘here’ to go to the Top Up page.
Note: These 3 login methods are different. The same account is required to log in and top up.
Click on MU and click "Continue".
Choose a payment method. and desired package After that, click on “Continue” (click ‘More payment methods’ to see other payment methods)
Note 1: Payment currency including Bonus Wcoin may vary per payment channel and package. Please check the currency and Bonus Wcoin before making payment.
Note 2: During a Bonus Cash event, the event end time is displayed on the top
Confirm your order and click 'Continue' to pay.
Select payment channel and click ‘Make Payment’.
Scan the QR with your mobile banking app.
If payment is successful, you will be able to check your balance amount on the 'Transaction History' page.
Click here to go to the Transaction History page.
For more information about the webshop, please click on these links.
Click here to go to the WEBSHOP page.

paragraphs: Here are the steps for purchasing items for your character from the online store.
Buying items is not difficult! Just follow these steps:
Go to MU Online's online item shop. There are various items that can be purchased with Wcoin.
Click ‘here’ to go to the ‘item shop’ page.
Click ‘here’ to go to the ‘top-up’ guide page.
Select a category to find the item you want to buy and click on ‘Buy Now’.
Confirm your order and click on 'Buy' to complete the order. You can check your remaining Wcoin balance on the Purchase Checkout page.
- Purchased items are valid for 1 year from the date of purchase.
- Unused items will be permanently deleted 1 year after the date of purchase.
- Some items can only be [used] in the game.
- Items marked with [SPEED] can only be used in SPEED SERVER.
Click 'Inbox' to view the purchased items or click 'OK' to stay on the store page to purchase additional desired items.
Click ‘here’ to go to the ‘Inbox’ page .
There are 3 categories on the Shopping List page where you can check your items and their status. You can delete items where if deleted the item will be permanently deleted.
Log in to your character and press 'X' to open the in-game X-shop. Select an item and click 'Use' to move the item to your character's storage.

headings.text: 3rd Class change requires finished Marlon quest and has 3 parts.

paragraphs: Receive Buff first before going out to hunt!!

Keep hunting with quests. This is the fastest way for level up.
You will meet more quests depending on your level.

Once you have reached level 150, go to the Priestess Sebina in Devias to hear the story of the 'Scroll of Emperor'. You will need to offer a token of 1 Million Zen for the Priestess's story.
The 'Scroll of Emperor', which tells of Muren, the first emperor to unify MU, is said to have been seen around the Lost Tower, Atlans, and the Dungeon.
Legends have been told of the Scroll being enveloped by a great power and whoever reads from the scroll shall be able to wield this power.Once you find the Scroll, go to the Priestess who will aid you in unlocking the Scroll's power.
As you feel the Scroll's power flowing through you, the Priestess relates the story of the peace brought about by Emperor Muren's reign. A historical record of the first emperor Muren contains the commemoration of peace through the triumph of Muren over all warlords, and by doing so, unified the continent into the Empire of MU.

Muren was one of the three Heroes that ended the chaos brought upon the people by Sekneum's invasion.
After the empire was united, people swore loyalty to the emperor. To signify this oath of loyalty the tribes offered three treasures.
The 'Broken Sword' was offered by the dark knights as a symbol of their bravery, loyalty and their wish for prosperity.
The 'Tear of Elf' was offered by the elves as a token of their vow to strengthen the unity between elves and humans. The 'Soul of Wizard' was offered by the dark wizards as a symbol of their vow to dedicate their power for the peace and freedom of the empire. The Priestess can assist you in furthering this quest if you give her a small token for her troubles worth 2 million Zen. She will then task you to seek one of the three treasures depending on which tribe you hail from.
Return the treasure to the priestess to complete this quest. Once you complete this quest you will become either: a Blade Knight, a Soul Master, or a Muse Elf.

The legendary treasure called 'Ring of Glory', once worn by the first emperor Muren has manifested its presence once more within our lands. Whoever possesses the 'Ring of Glory' gains the blessing of Muren. It is said to be found in the deserts across the sea.
Talk to Marlon who will appear in Devias, Lorencia, Noria, or Atlans. He will tell you more about the Ring once you give him a gift of 3 million Zen.
Return to Marlon once you have found the Ring of Glory to complete your transformation into one of the vanguards of the Continent of MU. For Blade Knights who thirst for a greater power talk to Marlon again once you finish this quest.

The Blade Knights possess a power that only they can wield. The ability to string together their techniques have made these knights extremely powerful and no other tribe has been able to emulate this.
The 'Dark Stone' calls out from the deserts.
It calls out to the brave Blade Knights to continue the legacy of their tribe and seek this skill.
Marlon, one of the keepers of the tribe's heritage, invites you to embark on this quest.
He requires an offering of 3 Million Zen as a symbol of your commitment. Bring to him the Dark Stone and unlock the true power of the Blade Knights.

paragraphs: After initial character creation, you can receive Tutorial quest by clicking on the exclamation mark on the bottom right.
The Tutorial quest is filled with contents designed to help players better understand MU and support them on their journey.
All characters under level 80 can begin the quest by clicking on the exclamation mark
▶ Ring of Fighter/Warrior
•  You can receive Ring of Fighter/Warrior after having finished all the Tutorial quests.
If you give up Tutorial quest, you can receive the Ring of Fighter/Warrior right away.
However, you can no longer proceed with the Tutorial quest.
Magic Gladiator / Dark Lord / Rage Fighter / Grow Lancer cannot receive Tutorial quest, nor receive Ring of Fighter/Warrior.
You can throw Ring of Fighter/Warrior on the ground after having reached level 40/level 80.
• Upon throwing the ring on the ground, one of the following items will be created from the randomly.
(Certain amount of zen may drop instead of items.)
Weapon/Equipment of item level ranging from 5~9 (Increase of damage/defense, Luck, Skill options may be applied variably)

paragraphs:
[4th Class Upgrade Background]
MU’s heroes who inherited the will of the priest of Light, Devin, have successfully defended Crywolf from Balgas and have been reborn as heroes with the sacred god Lugard’s blessing. However, their strength was not enough to defeat the new monsters and restore order in MU.
The priest, Devin, felt the need to unite the blessed heroes as one so he sought the strength and the ability from... one of the 12 priests of Light and Lugard's guardian knight, 'Sent', and asked her to test the ability of Mu's heroes again and pass down her power to those qualified.
'Sent', one of the 12 priests of Light, accepted Devin's desperate request and arrived in 'Lorencia' to meet the knights.

[NPC Sent]
A female knight with graceful figure. One of the 12 priests of Light and the guardian knight serving the sacred god Lugard.
She is adventurous and carries out the duties of Lugard's guardian knight in many places but
she now seeks the heroes with Lugard's blessing to test their ability and pass down her power and skill to those selected as requested by the 'Priest Devin'.
She arms herself with a great sword and a holy armor, both shining bright, and her body is protected by the Wind Zone under the Lugard's grace.
① Talk to Lorencia Town NPC Sent (131.147) to enter the Area of Eligibility
① The Area of Eligibility is where players make preparation before carrying out the quest.
② In the Area of Eligibility, players are able to form a party.
③ If one of the party member talks to Sent and chooses to enter the Test Area, all party members will progress to the Test Area.
④ Only characters with level 750 or higher may enter the Test Area.
⑤ Characters below level 800 are still able to enter the Test Area and assist the others completing the quest.
① The 4th Class Upgrade Quest can be done in the Test Area.
② The quest will be carried out in multiple stages based on the character who acquired the quest from Sent.
③ The quest is made up of 3 stages and completing the last stage will complete the 4th Class Upgrade Quest.
④ If the progress is interrupted by quitting play and returning to the town, the completed stages will be saved and the players can enter the Test Area again and resume the quest.

⑤ The 4th Class Upgrade Quest is made up of three stages:
Stage 1 -> Stage 2 -> Stage 3.
For example, a player who has not completed the stage 1 will not get the completion credit for the stage 2 even after clearing it together with another member who acquired the stage 2 of the quest.

a) If it is the first time doing the quest for 'Member 1', the stage 1 of the quest should be carried out and when it is completed, 'Member 1' and 'Member 2' will gain the status of the stage 1 completion. Other members will not be recognized for the completion of the quest.

b) If 'Member 3' acquires the quest while holding the status of the stage 1 completion, the stage 2 of the quest should be played out and when it is completed, 'Member 3' and 'Member 4' will gain the status of the stage 2 completion. Other members will not be recognized for the completion of the quest.

c) If 'Member 5' acquires the quest while holding the status of the stage 2 completion, the stage 3 of the quest should be played out and when it is completed, 'Member 5' will gain the status of the stage 3 completion. Other members will not be recognized for the completion of the quest.
a) The Scroll of Gray Oblivion is provided via the Gremory Case and stored in it for 7 days.

paragraphs: 1. 5th Advancement Background Story
Powerful Monsters with new powers have been found on the continent of MU, which was driven into chaos by Kundun.
A new force was required to combat the stronger Monsters, and after much sacrifice and research, a new power, “Extra DMG”
was discovered. Eunice, awaiting the powerful warriors of MU, was deployed to Devias to spread word of the new power.
2. 5th Advancement NPC Eunice
Eunice is a Guardian Knight that serves the Benevolent God Lugard, and also the older sister of Cent, one of the 12 Priests of Light.
Unlike Cent who is skilled with the sword, Eunice is skilled with the giant scythe (war scythe).
As one of the Guardian Knights deployed for the discovery of Extra DMG, Eunice is currently on a mission like her sister to
spread word of the new power to MU’s powerful warriors. Eunice has a friend that specializes in mechanical engineering,
a profession highly sought after in MU, and can often be seen helping her friend with research.
3. How to progress Quest
Eunice (Devias 193, 12)
1) Enter Quest Location (Realm of Privilege, Realm of Trials)
1-1) Realm of Privilege
- The Realm of Privilege is a place to prepare for Quests.
- You can find Party Members to progress Quests together in the Realm of Privilege.
- The Realm of Privilege can be accessed through “NPC Eunice”, located at Devias [193, 12].
- Only Characters Level 1,200 or above can enter.
- The Realm of Trials can be accessed through “NPC Eunice”, located at the Realm of Privilege.
- If one Party Member enters the Realm of Trials, all Party Members will also be moved to the Realm of Trials.

- The 1st Quest can be started through “NPC Eunice”, located at the Realm of Trials.

- Characters receive an “Extra Nuke DMG” Buff when doing the 1st Quest,
and the Quest will be Cleared if Eunice is Defeated within 1 Minute.

paragraphs: These dedicated warriors train endlessly to perfect their sword techniques.
They channel their high Agility and Physical Strength stats into direct and area attacks like
Twisting Slash, Death Stab and Rageful Blow.
By positioning himself in a defensive posture, a dark knight can reduce the damage taken from enemy strikes by 50%.
It proves very useful when besieged by too many enemies to effectively counter.
The falling slash gives twice as much damage than any other regular attack of a Dark Knight because he uses his whole body to increase the strength of the blow.
Many Dark Knights have been able to master this skill.
It consists of swinging a sword in a wide arc thereby generating enough centrifugal power to cause more damage and increase attack speed.
Dark Knights who use the Legendary Sword, Gladius and Katana with a lunge skill can execute quick stab attacks on their enemies.
Moreover, it penetrates deeply through an opponent's armor into the vital parts of the opponent.
It cleaves into an enemy through an upward slashing motion.
While it may look simple and fluid, it takes a lot of dedication to master it.
It is a dreadful skill that uses both blades of a sword to cut an enemy.
It is a skill of high difficulty that only a Giant Sword, Chaos Dragon Axe and Crystal Sword can handle.
Monsters who are attacked by this skill are damaged 2 times more than the other attacks.
This technique allows the knight wielding a spear weapon to impale his opponents for massive damage.
A technique that allows the knight to whirl his weapon around him to attack all adjacent targets.
A devastating attack similar to the lunge skill but is enhanced by the elemental power of wind.
This technique allows the knight to use his energies to give him more stamina for battle.
An area attack that unleashes shockwaves with the elemental power of the earth to damage opponents.

paragraphs: Character Renewal Class
Classes undergoing character renewal will have their Combat Power(%) attribute newly applied to display stronger attack.
Combat Power(%) attribute can be increased with Stat Points, Weapon and Item option increase for the character undergoing renewal.
1. Combat Power(%) Attribute Display
1) Character Information Window and Weapon Item Option Display Information
- Combat Power(%) is decided by the stat points of each class and equipping item with Combat Power(%) increase option will increase Combat Power(%) of the character.
The combined Combat Power(%) will be display accordingly in the Character Information window.
2) Character ATK and Skillpower Increase
- Character's Combat power(%) will proportionally increase character's ATK and Skillpower.
- Combat Power(%) is only applied to attacking skills.

- Increases hunting efficiency by increasing the attack skill range
and the damage range of Blow type skills using the Sword's Fury skill.

The Dark Knight's Sword Fury skill is maintained once it is used.
 After use, the range of the attack skill and the range of the blow type skills increases.

A Water Type Blow skill that causes damage over a wide range.
 Unlike Fire Blow, it deals damage by attacking in a wide damage range.

paragraphs: Character Renewal Class
Classes undergoing character renewal will have their Combat Power(%) attribute newly applied to display stronger attack.
Combat Power(%) attribute can be increased with Stat Points, Weapon and Item option increase for the character undergoing renewal.
1. Combat Power(%) Attribute Display

While tracking down the secret document of Kundun, the Imperial Knights arrive at the Lost Tower and finally meet face to face with Balrog. As they took down Balrog, they succeeded in obtaining the secret document in which they find a mysterious symbol... Fascinated by the mystical symbol, warriors engrave this mysterious symbol to their weapons and these weapons blackened as they possessed the power of Kundun.

Warriors of the MU continent go on an expedition to take down Black Lich and obtain the lightning power of Black Lich to their weapons. Countless warriors died in the process but in the end they took down Black Lich and obtained the lightning power to their weapons. But unable to control its power, Conmocion lance gets buried somewhere in Kantur.... While Arca of the Magic Kingdom struggled to find Conmocion Lance sealed away in Kantur, Grow Lancer, the resulting creature of countless experiments, and the only one who can manage the power of Conmocion Lance becomes the master of the lightning power.

Legendary Condor. The fluttering feathers of Condor are gentle but sharp and Warriors of MU continent wanted to make a powerful lance using this condor. Lance made from condor is both sharp and gentle at the same time and are able quickly suppress enemies by piercing deep into the heart of the enemy.

The master craftsman of Arca Kingdom worked hard to make a lance which can pierce deep into the enemy without much effort. After repeated experiments, they decided to add a socket to enhance the power of the lance and allow it to pierce the enemy with ease.

Suppressing the mutants became impossible with old weapons due to the virus that has spread in Kantur. So they wanted to suppress these mutants by using the lance crafted by the Kantur and Arca's academic union.  With added iron spikes, the prickle lance is effective in killing the enemy. This was the first lance produced jointly by Kantur and Arca and is used by Lancers to this very day.

A weapon used by Temple Knight Royal Guard of in Karutan. Scorpions in Karutan was the main material used to craft this weapon. With unique shape and material, it became one of lancer's favorite weapons to use. The split at the end of the lance was designed to cut the tendons of enemies.

While tracking down the secret document of Kundun, the Imperial Knights arrive at the Lost Tower and finally meet face to face with Balrog. As they took down Balrog, they succeeded in obtaining the secret document in which they find a mysterious symbol... Fascinated by the mystical symbol, warriors engrave this mysterious symbol to their weapons and these weapons blackened as they possessed the power of Kundun.

Legendary Condor. Condor feathers have been mixed in so it may not look as sturdy but it is impenetrable by any sword. All swords that have swung it's blade against this shield has shattered and only the light reflected by it's mere broken blade remained to be seen.
A cloth armor worn by apprentice Lancers. To account for both fast movement and defense, a skirt was added to the leggings and this has become the trademark of Grow Lancers.
An armor known to be bestowed to 'Dorf' by 'Broy.' Light and soft like silk. It shows no weakness in defense as it boasts fast mobility but reflects sharp weapons at the same time.

Princie Armor from master craftman 'Deruff' after an endless research. Made from melted metals, it boasts the best sturdiness all around. Symbol of Wing engraved to various parts of the armor adds swiftness to it.

headings.text: B. Rune Mage Character Basic Setting

paragraphs:
The Rune Mage is a half-elf who were born between the mage of Arka, an alliance of nobility, and the fairy who created the Altar of the Wolves.
As inter-species breeding is frowned upon in the Mu empire, they had to leave the empire and found a settlement called Iria and lived in peace.
When they came of age, the Lemuria Legion came to the village. They were heading to the front to join the Siege of Crywolf.
The Arka and the villagers tried to protect their village, but they were quickly overcome by the legionnaires.
In the chaos, the Rune Mage lost his parents. After the battle, the Rune Mage headed toward Noria for revenge.
-  Rune Mage's resources can be upgraded with character stats and items.
① Character stats can be upgraded with the stat points that players acquire when gaining a level or by using items.
① The Rune Mage is an offensive spellcaster who amplifies its Spellpower with Energy.
② They can cast more than two spells at a time to inflict serious damage over a wide area.

◈ 1st Class Change Quest
- Finding The Book of The Warlord
- The Three Artifacts of Mu (Mage's Spirit)

◈ 2nd Class Change Quest
- A Rightly Hero

◈ 3rd Class Change Quest
- Level 380: Proving Strength
- Level 400: Infiltrating the Valgath Barracks
- Level 400: Into the Darkness
① The Rune Mage can cast some warlock spells that he learned from his father's research and some unique spells available only to him.
① The Rune Mage uses a unique weapon called the Rune Mace and a shield.
② The Rune Mage can equip five armor pieces including helm, armor, pants, gloves, and boots.
① Like other classes, the Rune Mage can equip a Pentagram item.
② He can also equip accessories such as a necklace, rings, and earrings.
◈ As a socketed shield item, the Rune Mage can use the Frost Barrier items used by the fairies.
◈ As a socketed shield item, the Rune Mage can use the Light Load Shield items used by the fairies.

paragraphs: New Character Slayer Appears!!
A demi-human bat character with the capability to engage in quick combat with her bat-like abilities.
Uses a short sword(dagger) and engages in battle by throwing her weapon or charging into
multiple enemies far away.
1. Slayer Background Story
The slayer was originally born from Lorencia and was reincarnated through experiments in Kundun which turned her into a half-human half-bat
demi-human.1896 of Lugard ’s calendar, the demi-human experiment was discovered by Kundun’s forces in Kanturu.
To increase the power of their forces, they use the experiment to create demi-humans.
The slayer is the first successful demi-human created from the experiment.
Relentless Assassin...
After being abducted by the Kundun forces,
the slayer was recreated to become an obedient killing machine with no emotions.
A revered advanced demi-human with the intellectual of a human and the ability to
track and detect using sonar like a bat.
With her advanced tracking, detecting, and killing abilities,
she was used as an assassin by Kundun to assassinate traitors and those who were planning to commit acts of treason.
While she was working as a follower of Kundun, her human-like emotions
were being awakened by a mysterious woman.
She later discovers that the mysterious woman she assassinated as a traitor was her mother. She escapes the grasp of Kundun after discovering everything that has happened to her.
Now, away from the hands of Kundun, she battles with the will to assassinate him.
Creation Requirements
Can be created by default
Slayer, Dark Knight, Summoner
3. Exclusive Muun for Slayer - Deathmodus
The slayer character starts with the Deathmodus Muun.

paragraphs: Character Renewal Class
Classes undergoing character renewal will have their Combat Power(%) attribute newly applied to display stronger attack.
Combat Power(%) attribute can be increased with Stat Points, Weapon and Item option increase for the character undergoing renewal.
1. Combat Power(%) Attribute Display
1) Character Information Window and Weapon Item Option Display Information
- Combat Power(%) is decided by the stat points of each class and equipping item with Combat Power(%) increase option will increase Combat Power(%) of the character.
The combined Combat Power(%) will be display accordingly in the Character Information window.
2) Character ATK and Skillpower Increase
- Character's Combat power(%) will proportionally increase character's ATK and Skillpower.
- Combat Power(%) is only applied to attacking skills.

paragraphs: 1) Character Introduction
(1) White Wizard : Kundun Mephis
① Utilizing the opposite Element as that of the Dark Wizard,
the White Wizard uses Staves and Magic Books as Weapons and holy magic Skills using "Light Energy".
② Has low DEF but high Magic ATK.
You can strengthen your magic with the Energy Stat.
③ The "Bond Buff" is activated when in a Party together with Lemuria, his apprentice.
You can deal more DMG with strengthened magic Skills from the "Bond Buff".
① The Mage uses the "Orb"
to use magic Skills in the form of "spheres".
② Has low HP and DEF but high Magic ATK,
and you can strengthen your magic with the Energy Stat.
Although not as good as the Elf, can use similar support magic that helps in combat.
③ The "Bond Buff" is activated when in a Party together with Kundun, her teacher.
You can deal more DMG with strengthened magic Skills from the "Bond Buff".
* Kundun and Lemuria's Relation
- Kundun is Lemuria's teacher, and Lemuria is a woman that loves Kundun.
① After the discovery of the "Doppelganger Fortress" in MU Year 1022,
a Grand Sage from MU infiltrates the Fortress and meets the Doppelganger.
② With the strong intention to stop the evil Kundun, the Sage borrowed the Doppelganger's strength and started researching it,
with the research proving successful enough to produce the magic ability to create Doppelgangers.
③ A catalyst was needed for a Doppelganger to be created
and the Sage needed a Doppelganger of a person strong enough to stop Kundun.
Objects used by Kundun and Lemuria were obtained with the help of the priests that serve Lugard,
and with them as the catalysts, Kundun and Lemuria's Doppelgangers were made.
④ The Doppelgangers were identical in not only appearance but also memories, abilities, and personalites.
⑤ Under the guidance of their creator, the Doppelgangers developed kind and righteous hearts and the qualities of a White Wizard and a Mage,
and when the time came, the Sage sent Kundun and Lemuria on their way.
For the purpose of the good Doppelgangers to defeat their evil original selves and save the continent of MU….

(1) The Bond Buff is applied when in a Party together

(2) The Buff is applied to other Classes in the Party as well.
However, the Buff applied to them is different.
(3) The Buff disappears when the Party is disbanded or if Kundun and Lemuria become too far apart.

(1) The Bonding Cord is a buff that is applied when in a Party together
due to White Wizard: Kundun and Mage:Lemuria's bond with each other.
(2) The Bonding Cord is only applied between Kundun and Lemuria
and does not apply between Kundun and Kundun, Lemuria and Lemuria, and Party Members of other Classes.
(3) The Bonding Cord disappears when the Party disbands, when in a Safe Zone, and when Kundun and Lemuria become too far apart.
(4) The Bonding Cord can only be seen by Party Members.

Kundun and Lemuria form a Bonding Cord that connects each other

paragraphs: 1) Character Introduction
(1) Illusion Knight:  Jacquard
① A knight wielding the power of illusion, the Illusion Knight summons an Illusion Blade in his left hand to use Skills through various forms of Sword Energy.
② Has average DEF and high ATK.
③ Can enhance Skill ATK and ATK through the Dexterity Stat.
Born as an incarnation of Kundun, Jacquard had exceptional swordcraft and ability as a knight to surpass his peers without much effort,
but was not at all acknowledged as a Magic Gladiator due to his inability to wield a Magic Sword or use Magic, despite being a descendant of the Gladiators.
Jacquard has long since blamed his lack of ability and kept his heritage a secret.
He however had his moment of reckoning in the most unexpected of situations.
An illusion of his blade formed in the left hand he subconsciously held up in an attempt to defend against his opponent’s sword during training.
It was a new opportunity for Jacquard, who longed to be acknowledged.
Jacquard wasted no time honing his skills with illusions, and was soon able to create illusions of his weapons at will or create illusions of himself.
Having the ability that no one else had, the moment that he so desired finally had come.
There was hardly anyone in the continent of MU that did not know of Jacquard, who earned Kundun’s trust and was acknowledged by him.
Everything was going in Jacquard's favor for a while.
As his reputation grew, Jacquard’s loyalty towards Kundun only burned brighter,
and as his loyalty grew, it seemed as Kundun’s trust towards him was becoming much stronger.
One fateful day, Jacquard receives an order from Kundun in secret.
The order was to infiltrate the Blood Castle, a key strategic location, and destroy the barrier protecting it. Immediately taking action, Jacquard successfully carried out the mission.
Deeming the movements of Lemuria’s forces near the Lost Tower strange however,
Jacquard makes a report to Kundun and soon receives additional orders to investigate.
Lemuria’s forces noticed right away they were being tailed, and viciously attacked Jacquard with extreme hostility.
Lost in the heat of battle, Jacquard noticed there was not a single soul that was fighting alongside him.
The Lost Tower. Was this not the place full of Kundun’s subordinates?
Not knowing why he has to fight the enemy all by himself, Jacquard fights only to save his life.
Although able to save his life due to his illusion training, the heavily injured Jacquard loses conciousness while escaping into the depths of the Lost Tower.
How much time has passed?
Barely coming to his senses, Jacquard is engulfed in an uncontrollable rage. Kundun has forsaken me.
I, who am his incarnation. I, who pledged my loyalty. Jacquard knows only a path of burning retribution will save him now.
Only vengeance towards Kundun will help him escape the Lost Tower, where masses of Lemuria’s forces and Kundun’s subordinates aim their swords at him.
Renewed with vengeance as his new purpose, Jacquard enters combat once more with his Illusion Blade in hand.
Although countless enemies have fallen by his sword, his rage does not relent.
He goes forth. Until coming face to face with the Balrog, the ruler of the Lost Tower. The Balrog was a strong opponent.
An opponent that Jacquard had to put his life on the line for. A fierce battle ensued.
Jacquard faces his opponent with all his might. He had no intention of dying in the Lost Tower.
To Jacquard, there was an even greater opponent, an opponent that he must take down.
If he falls, he rises again. He wields his sword despite the pain.
Becoming one with the powerful energy of the sword, Jacquard delivers the final blow.
Thus the Balrog falls at last.
Jacquard escapes the Lost Tower drenched in the Balrog’s blood.
Forging his own path as the Illusion Knight, he strides towards a new battlefield to exact vengeance on Kundun.
Creation Requirements
Illusion Knight / Magic Gladiator / Elf
